findings.claim: The new spaces/ subfolder convention is applied only in the datasources layer, while the domain and routes layers keep spaces-core files mixed at the top level alongside feature subfolders, creating an inconsistent structure across the three layers.

Spaces-core files in the domain layer are not grouped into a spaces/ subfolder even though the datasources layer now uses this convention, so a reader has to learn that files without a subfolder belong to the spaces feature.

Spaces-core files in the routes layer (controller, service, DTO entities, guard) are not grouped into a spaces/ subfolder, leaving the same inconsistency as in the domain layer relative to datasources.
The commit message in 976f1ed contains a typo ("sl=plit" instead of "split") that should be corrected on squash-merge.
The file defines a single entity class SpaceSafe but the filename is plural, which is inconsistent naming; this is pre-existing but the refactor was an opportunity to fix it.
